basic_info.description: Location, location, location! Welcome to 350-352 6th Avenue, a beautiful duplex in the highly sought-after Inner Richmond District of San Francisco. This property features two spacious full-floor flats with formal living and spacious dining rooms, plus 2-3 bedrooms. The upper unit is currently available, features 3 bedrooms, 1 bath, formal living room, spacious family/dining room, large kitchen, offering a fantastic opportunity for an owner-occupant to live in one unit while renting out the tenant-occupied middle unit which offers 2 bedrooms,1 spacious family/dining room, living room and 1 bath. Additional highlights include a large backyard, a 2-car tandem garage, and vacant 2 bonus rooms, 1 bath at the garage lever with separate entrance. Enjoy proximity to popular attractions like Lands End, Sutro Baths, Lincoln Park Golf Course, and Golden Gate Park. The vibrant Clement Street neighborhood offers a wide variety of shops, restaurants, supermarkets, banks, and bars.
